# ValuePro Painting
> Owner-operated residential and commercial painting company based in Ballwin, Missouri, serving ten cities across St. Louis County. EPA Lead-Safe Certified for pre-1978 homes.

## Contact
- Phone: (314) 807-3883
- Email: info@valuepropainting.com
- Website: https://valuepropainting.com
- Service model: mobile — estimates at your property, no storefront

## Services
- [Interior Painting](https://valuepropainting.com/services/interior-painting): Walls, ceilings, trim and doors with low-dust prep, lead-safe on pre-1978 homes.
- [Exterior Painting](https://valuepropainting.com/services/exterior-painting): Siding, stucco, brick, fascia and soffit, scheduled to Missouri's seasonal application windows.
- [Cabinet Refinishing](https://valuepropainting.com/services/cabinet-refinishing): Sprayed factory-smooth cabinet finishes, in-shop or on-site.
- [Commercial Painting](https://valuepropainting.com/services/commercial-painting): Retail, office and light industrial repaints phased around business hours.
- [HOA Properties](https://valuepropainting.com/services/hoa-properties): Community association exteriors and common areas with board-ready proposals.
- [Drywall Repair](https://valuepropainting.com/services/drywall-repair): Patching, texture matching, priming and painting so repairs disappear.
- [Lime Wash & Specialized Painting](https://valuepropainting.com/services/lime-wash-specialized-painting): Lime wash, Venetian plaster and Roman clay hand-applied mineral finishes.

## Service Areas
- [Ballwin](https://valuepropainting.com/locations/ballwin): Home base; postwar subdivision housing, much of it pre-1978.
- [Chesterfield](https://valuepropainting.com/locations/chesterfield): Newer, larger elevations plus a substantial commercial base.
- [Wildwood](https://valuepropainting.com/locations/wildwood): Wooded estate lots; shaded, mildew-prone elevations.
- [Kirkwood](https://valuepropainting.com/locations/kirkwood): Historic districts and mid-century ranches; heavy pre-1978 stock.
- [Webster Groves](https://valuepropainting.com/locations/webster-groves): Inner-ring suburb, deep trim profiles, tight lots.
- [Manchester](https://valuepropainting.com/locations/manchester): Manchester Road corridor; residential plus storefront work.
- [Creve Coeur](https://valuepropainting.com/locations/creve-coeur): 1970s ranches, mid-century moderns and new infill.
- [Town and Country](https://valuepropainting.com/locations/town-and-country): Large properties requiring grounds protection.
- [Ellisville](https://valuepropainting.com/locations/ellisville): Transition between subdivision density and wooded acreage.
- [Des Peres](https://valuepropainting.com/locations/des-peres): Residential streets plus West County Mall-area commercial.
